items.title: MForMedia & Arcana Labs Sign AI Production Pact For Middle East
items.excerpt: Dubai's MForMedia will look to add AI workflows into its productions following a deal with Arcana Labs.
items.rationale: Concrete production deal putting Arcana Labs' AI workflows into a Dubai producer's slate — the AI pipeline is the whole story, and it opens a new region.

items.title: How Much of Filmmaking Can AI Agents Actually Do?
items.excerpt: In this video, we let GPT Astra organize and edit a video including doing VFX, SFX, and producing marketing assets. Check out our tutorial for what worked an...
items.rationale: Hands-on test of an AI agent running editing, VFX, SFX and marketing deliverables. It shows editors what an agent can and can't take off their plate today.

items.title: Mubi’s Efe Cakarel: “We are going to stay as far away from AI as possible when it comes to films”
items.excerpt: "We want machines doing a great deal of work in our lives; we just don't want them making the movies."
items.rationale: A major distributor/streamer CEO states a no-gen-AI content policy, which affects what filmmakers can pitch to Mubi. It is a different company from the published Katzenberg stance.

items.title: STUDIO STORIES: Tonic DNA, The Studio That Refused to Be One Thing
items.excerpt: Forty years in, Montreal’s Tonic DNA launches a refreshed identity, a new original holiday special, and a bet that AI can give hand-drawn animation a longer life. A conversation with partner …
items.rationale: A veteran Montreal animation studio explains how it uses AI to extend hand-drawn production, giving animators a practical studio-level case study.

items.title: 부산국제영화제 ‘포럼 비프’ 10월 8일 개막…AI 시대 영화의 미래 논의
items.excerpt: [더쎈뉴스 / The CEN News] 제31회 부산국제영화제(BIFF)에서 인공지능(AI)이 바꾸는 영화 제작 환경과 한국영화의 위기, 영화인의 권리 등을 놓고 국내외 영화인들이 머리를 맞댄다.부산국제영화제 지석영화연구소는 오는 10월 8일부터 11일까지 영상산업센터와 부산시청자미디
items.rationale: BIFF's Forum BIFF (Oct 8-11) puts AI-driven production and filmmakers' rights on its agenda, a timely Korean industry event. It is a different program from the published ACFM InnoAsia market.
